Recent clinical trial progress includes positive Phase IIa results for vortosiran and Phase II initiation of SRSD107, signaling growing momentum in addressing high-risk CAD patients beyond conventional treatments.

headlines.title: Homozygous Familial Hypercholesterolemia (HoFH) - 7MM Market, Epidemiology, and Forecast - 2036 | RNAi and Targeted Therapies Expand Uptake and Investment Opportunities
headlines.summary: The HoFH market is expected to expand through 2036, driven by improved genetic screening, earlier diagnosis, and adoption of targeted lipid-lowering therapies. With approximately 1,840 diagnosed prevalent cases in the 7MM in 2025, the market is shifting toward long-acting, receptor-independent therapies including RNA interference agents and ANGPTL3 inhibitors. Key unmet needs include limited treatment efficacy for patients with minimal LDL receptor function, delayed diagnosis, and high treatment burden.

headlines.title: Bone Metastasis in Solid Tumors Market Insights, Epidemiology, and 7MM Forecast - 2036 | Precision Oncology and Radiopharmaceuticals Unlock New Growth Opportunities
headlines.summary: The bone metastasis in solid tumors market is expected to expand from 2026-2036 across seven major markets, driven by rising cancer survival rates, improved diagnostics, and growing demand for targeted therapies and radiopharmaceuticals. The market is characterized by established treatments like denosumab and zoledronic acid, with emerging therapies including cabozantinib and radioligand treatments. Key unmet needs include limited disease-modifying therapies, persistent skeletal complications, and lack of validated biomarkers for treatment selection.

ACIU.title: uniQure Plunges on Additional Data From Huntington's Disease Study
ACIU.summary: uniQure (QURE) announced mixed phase I/II data for its investigational gene therapy ifezuntirgene inilparvovec for Huntington's disease treatment. At 36 months, the therapy showed 80% slowing in cUHDRS and 67% in TFC versus external controls. However, 48-month data showed weaker results with cUHDRS at 44% slowing (not statistically significant) and TFC at 61% slowing. The stock plunged 37% following the announcement. The company has submitted a BLA to the FDA based on 36-month data, with regulatory review and durability validation as key upcoming catalysts.

ACIU.title: AbbVie Wins FDA Nod for New Parkinson's Disease Drug Juvmo

Investors who held DNOW shares as of August 5, 2025 may be eligible to join the case, with a lead plaintiff deadline of October 2, 2026.

Investors who purchased Alibaba securities between June 26, 2025 and June 24, 2026 are encouraged to join the case, with a lead plaintiff deadline of October 5, 2026.

BABA.title: Will Accelerating Cloud & International Growth Lift Alibaba Stock Now?
BABA.summary: Alibaba is investing heavily in cloud and AI infrastructure with strong growth in these segments (45% revenue growth, 133% EBITA surge), but faces headwinds from declining international e-commerce revenues and massive capital expenditures that are compressing margins and turning free cash flow negative. The company has 50+ GW of geothermal capacity potential and $11.9 billion in binding agreements, but generates minimal current revenue ($174K in H1 2026) and faces substantial capital expenditure requirements ($2.2B+ for Cape Station Phase II through 2028). Trading at 74.38X forward sales—its lowest since IPO but still elevated—the stock leaves little room for execution setbacks.

FRVO.title: Fervo Energy Reaches First Power at Cape Station, Advancing EGS

The company is expanding Cape Station by 400 MW with approximately 900 MW of contracted offtake, demonstrating growing demand for reliable, carbon-free electricity.

IONQ.title: Classiq Introduces Fault Tolerance Engine to Bridge Quantum Applications and Fault-Tolerant Hardware
IONQ.summary: Classiq launched its Fault Tolerance Engine, a new capability that translates optimized logical quantum programs into fault-tolerant execution plans and measures physical resources and reliability needed for execution on fault-tolerant quantum computers. NWCI.title: AnaCardio raises €62.5 million Series B financing to advance transformational novel therapy in heart failure towards Phase 3 readiness

The funding will support Phase 2b development of AC01, a first-in-class oral ghrelin receptor agonist for advanced heart failure. AC01 demonstrated clinical proof of concept in Phase 1b/2a trials with a 22% increase in cardiac output and 4.8 percentage point improvement in ejection fraction, with favorable safety profile. The Phase 2b GOAL-HF2 study is expected to enroll first participants in Q4 2026, targeting Phase 3 readiness by 2028.
